name: Boardwalk
author: Charles Vestal
tagline: an arcade of music games for the FM-1
description: Boardwalk turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a seaside arcade of music games. Walk along the boardwalk at golden hour, the sea and the gulls behind you, and step up to a cabinet: ring the changes on a tower's bells, name a note by ear, play a song on falling tiles, fly a gull through a pier's posts, ride a roller coaster whose track is the melody. Every game pays out tickets, and the prize counter at the start of the row trades them for prizes, from a sticker to a giant teddy.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
